svg.title: Chronology does not establish identity
svg.desc: Separate chronological order from identity linkage: an ordinary time rule may continue beneath blocks, but the first two blocks retain a labelled relational gap above it.

"reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Location:** `documentary-evidence-field`

**Frame:** The first two blocks refuse to snap together. A dusty-amber bracket reads `RELATIONSHIP NOT PUBLICLY MAPPED`. The third block is connected only by forward time.

**Action:** Uncertainty becomes the central evidence.

**Caption:**
> AT LEAST TWO BOARDS. MORE THAN ONE MECHANISM.

**Provenance:** `disputed` + `compressed` — bounded synthesis of the two primary accounts.

", "title": "Chronology does not establish identity" } }
